taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: CloudFront signed URL/cookie policy and content publication boundary
controls.source_trace: Resolve the exact resource/time/IP policy and issuance authority, then determine whether alternate distribution/origin paths bypass the intended private delivery.
controls.implementation_branch: Inspect the actual distribution behavior and origin access path, not only a signed cookie. A custom policy can intentionally cover a path wildcard, while a direct public origin may bypass the distribution entirely. Separate URL expiry from an already-started transfer and signed access from per-customer entitlement; use owned marker objects for both paths.
controls.controlled_verification: Use owned synthetic objects/distribution paths and compare allowed signed delivery with an unauthorized path or expired capability.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A cached object intentionally published publicly is not a signature bypass; a valid bearer sharing a capability follows its declared model.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind signer scope and origin protection, then verify authorized delivery and rejected alternate paths.
